entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: I did not refund. I surrendered the imprest.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Was there any penny of that money that you allege attributable to the governor, going to his pocket?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: I said the money was meant for the First Lady and the Ward Administrator who were travelling to the United Stated of America for the conference.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Was the visit approved officially?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: Yes. The visit was approved.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: When you come to your statement, let me take you back to your affidavit on page 1121. Is there anywhere that you attribute the execution of any of those documents to the governor?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: No, I do not.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: You have stated in paragraph 12, 1121, that you compiled all the documents with respect to the trip, which includes the air tickets, boarding passes as well as accommodation. You did omit from your compilation of documents the documents relating to your money, which you took from the county.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: I surrendered all the documents.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: I am saying when you were compiling the documents, you omitted the documents that prove you took the money from the county government.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: Pardon?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Sen. (Prof.) Kamar)
entries.speaker_title: The Deputy Speaker
entries.text: Please come out clearly because even me, I am not clear on what you are asking.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: I said that she mentioned that the trip was authorized but the documents that she has tendered do not show that. She says that she had Kshs2.6 million which she took and refunded but there was US$5000, but there is no evidence of that. The completion of the documents is what she says.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: Madam Deputy Speaker, I want to correct my statement and say that the counsel is misquoting me. I have put it clearly that the Kshs2.6 million I that I took, if you go to document 1125 it is Authority to Incur Expenditure signed by me to the County Secretary. The Authority to Incur Expenditure is Her Excellency the First Lady will be accompanied by the others to the mentioned conference in New York, United States of America scheduled to take place from 12th to 23rd March, 2018. The people who were to accompany Her Excellency the First Lady were Ms. Janet Muthoni Gichuki of passport No. B174362 who was then a County Executive Committee Member for Education, Youth Gender and Social Services and one Ms. Saumu Agnes Mbuvi of passport No. B168652. That authority was approved by the County Secretary. After that, the procedure is, it goes to the paymaster who completes the per diems before the document goes back to the accountant for the preparation of the payment vouchers to the beneficiaries.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: I was ending my question. All that documentation of the approvals, the vouchers and everything you have not included.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: All the documents are here. There is no document that I did not submit.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Sen. (Prof.) Kamar)
entries.speaker_title: The Deputy Speaker
entries.text: Thank you. Any other?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Kevin Kokebe
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Madam Deputy Speaker, it is my turn to re-examine the witness. Ms. Kinyanjui, you have been referred to your testimony from the special declaration. You have referred this hon. House to the document on page 1125.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Kevin Kokebe
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: In that document, what was the designation of the person, Saumu Agnes Mbuvi?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: I did not fill any designation when I was doing the Authority to Incur Expenditure because I did not have her designation. I, however, indicated the designation of the County Executive Committee Member (CECM).

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Kevin Kokebe
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: That is fair enough. Later on, you got an invoice. It has been asked that you received some Kshs2.6 million. Is it so?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: Yes, I received an invoice.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Kevin Kokebe
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Hon. Senators, the invoice in question is on page 1126 - 1127.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel of the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: Sorry to interject, Madam Deputy Speaker. This is a redoing of the case, with tremendous respect. The documents that are being referred to, they did not take her through.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Kevin Kokebe
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Madam Deputy Speaker, my learned Senior knows well that he has referred to Kshs2.6 million. The Kshs2.6 million he is referring to is in that invoice. I am further laying evidence before this court that he has referred to a Kshs2.6 million, which is in here. Madam Deputy Speaker, hon. Members, to the next point, I refer you to yet another document that is on page 1133, which again, is where Mr. Kinyanjui began. Hon. Senators, if we are all there, Ms. Kinyanjui, kindly read what the purpose for this money on 1133 was on. What was the purpose for that money?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: Nature of duty being imprest for the County First Lady and Ward Administrator to travel to the United States of America (U.S.A.)

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Kevin Kokebe
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: A ward administrator that you did not know at first? Is that so?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: I was not given the designation.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Kevin Kokebe
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Thank you. You also referred to an issue that you received money. Who did you give this money? How did it leave your account?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: On the morning of 19th March 2018, I was in the office, and one Christopher Mbwaga Obuso, who was then a security detail to the governor called me and asked me where I was. I told him that I was in the office. Then he told me that he was coming. Within a short while, because I was on the same floor as the governor, he came and found me in the office. He told me, twende ukatoe pesa ya First Lady. We went down to Co-operative Bank, City Hall Branch. I withdrew the money and gave that money to Christopher Mbwaga Obuso. It is important to say that after which, because it was an imprest warrant---

entries.label: scene
entries.text: (Loud consultations)

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Njiiru Ndegwa
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for the Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Madam Deputy Speaker, there was a question about the money and how she expended it. She is expounding on that point in re-examination. We have a right to rebut that preposition. It is in her document. It is in evidence. It is on page 1134. That is what she is referring to.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Sen. (Prof.) Kamar)
entries.speaker_title: The Deputy Speaker
entries.text: That is alright. I think that question actually came from the counsel of the governor. He raised a clear exposition of that Kshs2.6 million, so we are all trying to follow it. Please, enable us to follow it because the judgement is tomorrow and things should be as clear as they should be. Last question, please. You have only one minute.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Kevin Kokebe
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Thank you, Madam Deputy Speaker. I beg that I take two minutes on the last question because this is an issue that was raised. Ms. Kinyanjui, how was that money to be spent? How did it leave your account?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Harrison Kinyanjui
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel of the Nairobi City County Governor)
entries.text: That has been answered already.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Sen. (Prof.) Kamar)
entries.speaker_title: The Deputy Speaker
entries.text: She has already answered that one. I agree. She has already said that there was a security guard who came and took the money. I heard it myself.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Kevin Kokebe
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Madam Deputy Speaker, it will be prejudicial to my client that---

entries.label: scene
entries.text: (Loud consultations)

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Kevin Kokebe
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Madam Deputy Speaker, kindly protect me from my learned friends. Hon. Speaker and Members of this honorable House, the question was asked and I am only referring to it.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Sen. (Prof.) Kamar)
entries.speaker_title: The Deputy Speaker
entries.text: Which question---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Kevin Kokebe
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: The question that I am putting to the witness is as simple as what it is: How was the money to be expended based on the evidence that is there? Hon. Speaker, I invite you to look at 1143.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Sen. (Prof.) Kamar)
entries.speaker_title: The Deputy Speaker
entries.text: Counsel, I am looking for the shortest time for Members to seek clarifications. The clearer you are the better. I will only have 10 minutes for Members after you have finished. Answer that question precisely, and that is the last.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: Before I go to 1143, I want to start from 1126 for which I received the invoice from Premier Plan Agency. It is H.E. County First Lady, Nairobi City County, Ms. Primrose Mweru Mbuvi, attendance to CSW conference New York, 14 days; international private airport transfer chauffer driven, accommodation in New York for nine days and conference side events/ meetings. There was also local transport cost, set-up and side meetings, hall space bookings, local tourist sites and museum costs and miscellaneous.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Sen. (Prof.) Kamar)
entries.speaker_title: The Deputy Speaker
entries.text: By the way we have those details.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Ms. Joyce Kinyanjui
entries.text: Then the other cost was for---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Sen. (Prof.) Kamar)
entries.speaker_title: The Deputy Speaker
entries.text: We have those details. So, let us not repeat because Members have already read your statements.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Mr. Kevin Kokebe
entries.speaker_title: (The Counsel for Nairobi City County Assembly)
entries.text: Thank you. I am glad the House has taken note of that. I will be yielding, Madam Deputy Speaker and the honourable Members.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Sen. (Prof.) Kamar)
entries.speaker_title: The Deputy Speaker
entries.text: Hon. Senators, we had promised that we would allow you a few minutes in case you have question or clarification to all the witnesses of the County Assembly.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: An hon. Senator
entries.text: Imetutosha

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Sen. (Prof.) Kamar)
entries.speaker_title: The Deputy Speaker
entries.text: Addiction to the Kiswahili dictionary is landing even on this Chair. Hon. Members, are we all satisfied?

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Senators
entries.text: Yes.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Sen. (Prof.) Kamar)
entries.speaker_title: The Deputy Speaker
entries.text: Thank you, very much, Senators.

entries.label: heading
entries.text: ADJOURNMENT

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: (Sen. (Prof.) Kamar)
entries.speaker_title: The Deputy Speaker
entries.text:
Hon. Senators, it is now time to interrupt the business of the Senate. The House, therefore, stands adjourned until tomorrow, Thursday, 17th December, 2020, at 9.00 a.m.

The Senate rose at 8.55 p.m.
